name: SLHS 4251
title: Introduction to Articulation, Voice, and Fluency Disorders
description: Communication problems resulting from disorders of speech, voice, and fluency. Assessment and management strategies in settings including public schools, hospitals, and rehabilitation centers.
requirement_description: SLHS 2156, 2203, 2204, and 3247; open to juniors and higher. May not be taken out of sequence after passing SLHS 4335.
